title: Cardiology Consultation
html: The July JADA article by Sandhu and colleagues titled “Medical Clearance Considerations for Medically Complex Adult Patients” (Sandhu S, Newsome L, Shazib M. JADA. 2026;157[7]:716-726.), although helpful, continues the long tradition of assuming medical providers are the ultimate authority on issues of dental therapy. Specifically, the authors suggest, “Cardiology consultation may be required when using high-[electromagnetic interference] tools such as monopolar electrosurgical units or magnetostrictive ultrasonic scalers (eg, Cavitron; Dentsply Sirona).” I assure you that most medical providers have absolutely no idea what a magnetostrictive ultrasonic scaler is, how it operates, or how it is used.
